# OMP008 `implicit-target-map`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

The compiler maps data implicitly for an OpenMP target region (nvfortran: 'Generating implicit map').

## Why

Variables used in a `target` region without a `map` clause are mapped implicitly; arrays default to
`tofrom`, a copy in and out at every execution of the region. In an iterative loop that is a transfer
per iteration. Keep the data on the device with `target enter data` / `target data` and map exactly
what each region needs (`map(to:)`, `map(from:)`, or nothing when present).
Reported only with `fobis lint --compiler-feedback LOG` (see the linting guide).

## Reported

```fortran
!$omp target teams distribute parallel do     ! nvfortran: Generating implicit map(tofrom:y(:))
do i = 1, n
  y(i) = 2 * y(i)
end do
```

## Preferred

```fortran
!$omp target enter data map(to: y)
...
!$omp target teams distribute parallel do
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[OMP008] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = OMP008` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
